# What did that lumper fee really cost you?

> Free lumper fee calculator for truckers and owner-operators: enter the lumper receipt, the dock wait and each way the broker might pay you back, and see what you are really out. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
